children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - August 28, 2026) - Silverstock Metals Inc.
Silverstock
" or the "
Company

") announces that Messrs. Tom Panoulias and Gerald Shields have resigned as directors of the Company effective August 27, 2026. The Company is pleased to announce that Messrs. Chris Osterman and Leo Karabelas have been appointed as directors of the Company, effective August 28, 2026, to fill the vacancies created by the resignations.

Jonathan Fruchter, Chief Executive Officer and President of the Company, commented: "On behalf of the Board, I would like to thank Tom and Gerry for their service and contributions to Silverstock. We are pleased to welcome Chris and Leo to the Board and look forward to benefiting from their experience and perspectives as the Company evaluates opportunities for its next stage of development."
Chris Osterman
Chris Osterman has thirty years' experience in both metal production and exploration in North and South America, Africa, and Asia.

Most recently, Dr. Osterman played an integral role in the discovery and development of the San Jose silver deposit in Oaxaca, Mexico; and the Zuun Mod molybdenum deposit in Mongolia. Dr. Osterman's area of expertise lies in new project reconnaissance and exploration strategy. Dr. Osterman completed a PhD at the Colorado School of Mines focusing on sediment-hosted copper deposits in Namibia.
Dr. Osterman holds a BSc Mining Eng., MSc Geol. Eng. and PhD Geology.
Leo Karabelas

Leo Karabelas is a mining executive and capital markets professional with more than 20 years of experience in corporate development, investor relations, strategic financing and corporate communications. He currently serves as Vice President, Capital Markets at San Cristobal Mining Inc., where he played an instrumental role in the Company’s 2023 acquisition of Minera San Cristóbal.

Mr. Karabelas is also the founder and President of Focus Communications, a Toronto-based investor relations, corporate communications and advisory firm focused primarily on the natural resources sector. Throughout his career, he has advised numerous public and private mining companies on capital markets strategy, financing and corporate growth.
He currently serves as a Director of Labrador Gold Corp. and previously held the position of Vice President of Corporate Communications at Novo Resources Corp.
Mr. Karabelas holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree in Management and Enterprise Development from Ryerson University.
About Silverstock Metals Inc.

Silverstock is a mineral exploration company focused on identifying and evaluating opportunities to acquire interests in mineral properties globally. The Company's objective is to acquire and advance prospective precious and base metal properties that it believes have the potential to create value for shareholders.
